Animal Factory Tactics 3D

Painted animal characters, industrial environments, and an isometric tactical world. Explore the new character direction and the environment prototype.

Inspect a map in 3D

Open the authored factory or import a map or reusable block. Inspect actual models, floor layers and logical footprints from five camera views. Edit full maps, save designs and playtest your changes.

Open the 3D map editor →

Play a 3D encounter

Lead four modeled workers through the factory with movement, shooting, reloading and guard turns. Easy reveals the scenery while opponents still require line of sight. Character animation and the wider game interface are in progress.

Play the first encounter →

All-character motion studies

Test all twelve smaller character models at prototype scale. Eleven carry and fire a rifle; the hen has an unarmed walking and crouching study. Per-character visual holds are recorded in the viewer.

Open motion studies →
